# Security reporting

WoG Storage Helper is maintained by **deniy**. This is beta software; no external
security audit or broad hardware assurance is claimed. The current signing
preparation does not mean a signed release has been published.

For sensitive reports, use this repository's **Security → Report a vulnerability**
feature when enabled. Do not put credentials, private profiles, user screenshots,
contact details or signing tokens into public issues. If private reporting is
unavailable, ask the maintainer for a private reporting channel before posting
sensitive details. No unverified contact address is supplied here.

Normal operation is local and uses ordinary screenshot/input APIs. Profiles,
diagnostic frames, logs, credentials and previous binaries are excluded from
source exports. Signing requests require separately configured provider access
and never publish a release automatically. See [code signing policy](../docs/CODE_SIGNING.md).
